purpose: Expose assumption-conditional power and precision for the frozen primary external comparison before any full-test result is accessed.

assumptions: Independent generation seeds define independent dataset-level paired blocks.
The three fixed algorithm seeds are averaged within each dataset and configuration before inference.
A normal location approximation is used only to make prospective operating characteristics explicit.
The planning alpha is the conservative first Holm threshold; the actual analysis remains the predeclared Friedman plus paired Holm procedure.
Power depends on the unknown paired-score distribution and these values are scenario sensitivities, not guarantees.

reporting.required_caveat: These prospective calculations are conditional on declared normal-location scenarios and do not replace the exact frozen nonparametric analysis.
